status: PROPOSED labels by Claude, NOT yet checked by the owner (OT-35). Do not treat as ground truth.
privacy: PRIVATE REPOSITORY ONLY: real players, possibly minors. Never copy into seed data, previews, screenshots, docs outside tests/ or any web service.
source: tests/fixtures/real-titles.raw.json (70 titles, byte-exact in two captures); entries map by position (index) and repeat the title so drift is detectable.

label_conventions.kind: match | non_match | team_tie. A title with no VS token is a non_match (spec A.4); team sides are a team_tie (PC-16).
label_conventions.side_split: clear = a slash or ampersand separates partners (or the side is one name); inferred = split by the D-017 legacy rule (a doubles word and exactly two tokens per side, or the new-convention rule that a slash-less side is one player); ambiguous = the title does not decide it, players is null and plausible_readings lists the options.
label_conventions.format: singles | doubles | unknown. Never inferred from first names or a name's apparent gender; category only from an explicit token.
label_conventions.category_age: category only from an explicit token; age_group only from an explicit age word; minor_signal_in_title is false everywhere in this set (no under-age token occurs in these 70 titles).
label_conventions.tournament: series name WITHOUT the year; spelling kept as written (typos are noted, not fixed).
label_conventions.confidence_of_label: high = the title decides every field; medium = one or two fields are an inference; low = the title does not decide format or players.
label_conventions.unsure: true when at least one label field is a genuine judgement and the owner should look at it first; unsure_fields names them. First-name-only players and text before side A are listed in risk_tags: they make PARSING hard but do not by themselves make the label uncertain.
label_conventions.review_state: proposed -> owner_confirmed | owner_corrected (set during OT-35 spot checks).
